title: THE AXIOMS OF STRUCTURAL REALISM
subtitle: The foundational assumptions Kenneth Waltz placed beneath the system.
source: Waltz, K. (1979). Theory of International Politics.
framing: Realist analysis presupposes four claims about the international system. Each is contestable; none is obvious.

axioms.text: The international system is anarchic — no authority stands above states.
axioms.gloss: The foundational assumption; everything else follows.

axioms.text: States are the principal units; non-state actors operate within state-permitted bounds.
States are rational unitary actors maximising security and survival.
axioms.gloss: Disputed by behavioralists, bureaucratic-politics scholars, and constructivists.

axioms.text: States cannot be certain of others' intentions, so capabilities matter more than declared aims.
